bounded_changes.binary_scope: Each downloaded official Linux x64 and Mac ARM64 archive contains exactly one regular file named antigravity; its size and digest are frozen in dist-inventory.json. The public source compare for each tag exposes only CHANGELOG.md. No downloaded binary was executed.
bounded_changes.unmapped: Release-note changes to conversation UI, headless agent requests, settings, authentication, tools, permissions, usage, files, plugins, remote control, and other commands remain provider-internal or outside the selected catalogue mapping unless a hop says otherwise.
bounded_changes.model_api_retry_note: The 1.2.13 note describes retry delays for model API requests. The official headless guide identifies agy models separately as the model-slug listing command; no catalogue-specific list-output or lifecycle change is published. This scope classification is an inference from those official materials; static metadata cannot transfer to live catalogue honoring.
bounded_changes.deferred: No antigravity.headless claim, deferred headless interior point, ACP registry, exact hosted alias, or launcher is qualified here.
